videos.script: An on-sale at ten in the morning. More buyers than the box office can serve, whatever its size. {{onsale}} Without guards it fails in order: the rate stops growing, the waiting grows, and then a hundred and forty six sales fail in the database, which ran out of connections. {{overload}} First guard: a bucket of tokens per buyer, in Redis, so every copy shares it. A bot gets six tickets in its first second and two a second after that. {{bucket}} Second guard: a fixed number of slots. Past them, a request is refused at the door, and the database stays inside its limit. {{shed}} A refusal only helps if the caller listens. That is backpressure. {{pressure}} Then the guards on the way out. A timeout of one second, and a trace that shows the charge going on for five more. {{timeout}} And a circuit breaker: after five failures it stops calling payments, answers in two milliseconds, and later tests its way back. {{breaker}}
